chapterInfo.content:
12
Hiob ma mmuaeɛ
1Na Hiob gyee so sɛ:
2Yoo! Mone ɔman no nne,
na mowu a, nyansa bɛwu.
3Me nso, mewɔ nteaseɛ sɛ mo ara,
me deɛ, mentɔ mu mo anim.
Na hwan na ɔnnim nnoɔma a ɛte sɛɛ yi?
4Deɛ ne yɔnko sere no ne me,
deɛ ɔsu frɛɛ Onyankopɔn na ɔgyee no soɔ,
wɔsere ɔteneneeni a ɔdi mu no.
5Deɛ ɔte hɔ dwoodwoo no tirim deɛ, animtiabuo na ɛfata amanehunu,
ɛne deɛ wasiesie ama wɔn a wɔn nan watirie.
6Amimfoɔ ntomadan si hɔ dwoodwoo,
na wɔn a wɔhuru Nyankopɔn boɔ te hɔ komm,
wɔn a wɔkura wɔn nyame wɔ wɔn nsam no.
7Na yei deɛ, bisa mmoa ɛ, na wɔnkyerɛ wo,
ne ɔsoro nnomaa nso, na wɔnka nkyerɛ wo.
8Anaasɛ bisa asase hwɛ, na ɛnkyerɛ wo,
na ɛpo mu mpataa nka nkyerɛ wo.
9Hwan na ɔrenhunu yei nyinaa mu
sɛ AWURADE nsa na ɛyɛɛ yeinom?
10 # Num 16.22 Ne nsam na ɔteasefoɔ biara kra wɔ,
ne adasamma nyinaa ahonhom.
11Ɛnyɛ aso na ɛsɔ nsɛm hwɛ,
na dodom nso ka aduane hwɛ?
12 # Hiob 8.8 Nkɔkoraayɛ mu na nyansa wɔ,
na onyinkyerɛ ma nhunumu.
13Ɔno nkyɛn na nyansa ne mmaninneɛ wɔ,
ɔno na afotuo ne nhunumu wɔ no.
14Hwɛ, ɔdwiri, na wɔrento,
ɔto onipa mu, na wɔremmue.
15 # 1 Ah 17.1, 7; Gye 7.19-23 Hwɛ, ɔsianka nsuo ma no we,
nanso ɔgyaa mu ma no butu asase.
16Ɔno nkyɛn na ahoɔden ne nyansa wɔ,
deɛ wɔdaadaa no ne ɔdaadaafoɔ nyinaa yɛ ne dea.
17Ɔpa apamfoɔ ho de wɔn kɔ,
na ɔma atemmufoɔ dane nkwaseafoɔ;
18ɔsane ahemfo nkyehoma,
na ɔde nhoma kyekyere wɔn asene.
19Ɔpa asɔfoɔ ho de wɔn kɔ,
na ɔde wɔn a wɔatim no hwe fam;
20ɔma anotefoɔ gyae kasa
na ɔgye mpanimfoɔ nimdeɛ;
21ɔde animtiabuo gu mmapɔmma so,
na ɔhodwo nnɔmmarima abɔsoɔ mu.
22Ɔyi adeɛ kuronkuron adi firi sum mu;
na ɔde sum kabii firi ba hann mu;
23ɔma aman dɔɔso, na ɔsɛe wɔn;
ɔtrɛ amanaman mu, na ɔtu wɔn kɔ,
24ɔgye asase so aman mu atitire akoma.
Na ɔma wɔkyini asasesofoɔ a ɔkwan nni hɔ so.
25 # Hiob 5.14 Wɔkeka sum a hann nni hɔ mu,
na ɔma wɔkyini sɛ nsaboni.

ɔsane ahemfo nkyehoma,

Ɔpa asɔfoɔ ho de wɔn kɔ,

ɔma anotefoɔ gyae kasa
na ɔgye mpanimfoɔ nimdeɛ;
ɔde animtiabuo gu mmapɔmma so,
na ɔhodwo nnɔmmarima abɔsoɔ mu.
Ɔyi adeɛ kuronkuron adi firi sum mu;

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
